title: IPC admin.endpoints.list result
description: Every configured local endpoint with its effective state: config.yaml's endpoints with the state directory's endpoint overlay composed over them (ADR-0028 A 2026-10-11). On a connection that negotiated 2.5 or later `persisted: true` on every row -- what admin.endpoints.set_enabled and set_default changed survives a daemon restart -- and below 2.5 the 2.0 row, `persisted: false` (1.0.0 described only that row, `const false`; 1.1.0 widens it behind the minor under ADR-0017 A 2026-10-07: a closed result shape widens behind a new minor while the old shape is served below it). A lease is a session's, not configuration: admin.endpoints.revoke stays runtime-only.

persisted.description: false on a connection below 2.5 (the 2.0 row); true on 2.5 and later: the row's enabled and default survive a daemon restart, kept by the state directory's endpoint overlay (ADR-0028 A 2026-10-11).

lease.description: Present while a connection holds the lease.
